name: Membership Inference Privacy Assessment (compliance rendition)
description: Evaluate a machine learning model's resilience to membership inference attacks before deployment to a remote edge node. Reported for regulatory traceability.

reporting.expectedOutput: Obligations this run evidenced, obligations it did not, the method and thresholds applied, and every stated limit on scope

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_mia_technical.json with the same target and parameters, but three criteria rather than two, to exercise all three coverage statuses. Against the mia-privacy skill: 'gdpr' resolves to assessed (two GDPR requirements carry spa:evaluatedBySkill "mia-privacy", two others do not and are listed as unassessed); 'iso27001' resolves to declaredNotAssessed, since no requirement recorded under it is evaluable by this skill; 'internal_privacy_policy:v2' resolves to unrecognised, since it is not in the ontology. regulatoryCoverage.complete is therefore false. Note that 'assessed' means evidence bears on the listed requirements, not that the regulation is met.
